title: Label-Leakage Audit — CashGuard AI (SIH26184 prototype)

root_cause.description: Rolling-window features and the target label were constructed on the SAME calendar day. Day-keyed aggregates computed at day d included day d's own complaints/withdrawals — the exact window being predicted — so the features leaked the label into the training/evaluation pipeline. This inflated validation ROC-AUC to the ~0.92x range.
root_cause.defect_class: CWE-200 / temporal leakage (target-window contamination), not a modelling error
root_cause.observed_effect: held-out ROC-AUC reported as ~0.927x was an artifact of same-day feature/label construction; not a real separability signal

fix.summary: Day-keyed feature frames are now shifted forward by one day in _shift_day_past so a row keyed day == d carries ONLY data observed strictly before the start of day d (<= d-1). Rolling windows no longer include the target day.
fix.mechanism: frame['day'] = frame['day'] + pd.Timedelta(days=1) applied to complaint, complaint-type, centroid, account, and counterparty aggregates; withdrawal hourly features already use the hour bucket immediately before each day start.
fix.verification: per-feature AUC audit re-run; strongest single-feature AUC is now days_since_epoch 0.5604, no feature approaches 0.92; leak signature patterns (the removed fraud_withdrawals_24h 1.0-style dominance) no longer present

numbers.leaky_interpretation: INVALID — artifact of same-day feature/label construction. May be cited only as the explicitly-invalidated leaky baseline; never as valid model performance.

repro_steps: 1) Checkout/reconstruct the pre-fix features.py where _shift_day_past was absent or not applied to all day-keyed aggregates.
2) Build features and target on the same day grid for the held-out window; train the XGBoost + platt-sigmoid pipeline with split_day 2026-07-07.
4) Apply the fix: shift every day-keyed aggregate frame forward by one day so features use only data <= d-1.
5) Re-train and re-evaluate on the same split — observe ROC-AUC dropping to 0.6344 (immediate honest re-run), and 0.6273 in the final consolidated run (artifacts/metrics.json).
6) Confirm no single feature AUC approaches 0.92 (see artifacts/metrics.json per_feature_auc).

artifacts_audited.note: final forecast-safe numbers: ROC-AUC 0.6273, P@20..1000, prf@thresholds, per_feature_auc
re-run on corrected pipeline: random 0.627, time_forward 0.6263, cold_atm 0.5963, cold_city/cold_district 0.6228, new_hotspot 0.5847
authoritative manifest of honest vs superseded deep-eval artifacts

superseded_artifacts.note: still holds leaky 0.8038-0.897; honest re-run of completed worlds = 0.6321 / 0.6386 (see RECONCILIATION.md)

conclusion: The previously reported ~0.9275 ROC-AUC was solely an artifact of same-day feature/label leakage and is INVALID as a model-performance claim. After the day-keyed shift fix, the honest forecast-safe held-out ROC-AUC is 0.6273 on the synthetic test set. All headline evaluation artifacts cited in this deliverable set were re-run on the corrected pipeline and carry honest numbers; every remaining 0.92x figure in the repo (per RECONCILIATION.md) is the explicitly-superseded leaky baseline and must not be cited as valid. The honest 0.6273 is a score on SYNTHETIC labels (see REAL_DATA_GAP.md and LABEL_VALIDITY.md), not real-world fraud.
